blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — A female motorcyclist allegedly driving while intoxicated and without a helmet, and a truck helper died in separate road accidents in Quezon province on November 23, police reported on Tuesday, November 24. The 23-year-old motorcycle rider was traveling along the national highway in Barangay Mayao Parada at 9:30 p.m. when she allegedly lost her balance and control of the motorcycle, causing her to crash onto the road. The rider, who was not wearing a protective helmet, sustained fatal head injuries. Rescuers rushed her to the Quezon Medical Center, where she was declared dead on arrival.
